long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: I am hungry and the bowl is where dinner is, though it is empty for now, so I will check it anyway.
The reading lamp is on the desk and it is mine, and I want to see it is still there.
I have not finished with the seeds, and the unknown ones still need an answer.

steps.makes: a note on the moon's colour
steps.reason: I have observed the moon and I will put the result down before anyone else can claim it.
My energy is running low and a patch of sun is the proper remedy for it.

today.reason: Hunger has run down and the bowl is empty until morning, so I will check on it, then go back to reading and writing up what I saw, and rest in the sun after.
